messages:
Priya (VP Infra): thanks for joining the brief follow-up — posting answers for APAC warm-pools, autoscale playbook, and H100 pilot questions. ask quick Qs here.

Tom (Platform): are APAC warm-pools 24/7 or time-windowed? need to tell a customer.

Priya (VP Infra): v1: critical APAC zones keep a tiny always-on reserve (2 nodes). non-critical zones may use time-window policies to save cost.

Rosa (SRE): what latency uplift for cross-region fallback? we need wording for support.

Priya (VP Infra): safe wording: expect ~+45 to +150ms depending on region pair. recommend Dedicated pinning for stricter guarantees.

Arjun (Capacity): quick note on autoscaler: sequence on spike = burst credits -> warm-pool scale -> reprovision from regional reserve (60–120s) -> cross-region fallback. cooldown default = 180s, smoothing 60s.

Selina (Product): H100 pilot timeline? customers pressed for demo access.

Arjun (Capacity): partners indicate arrival next quarter; pilot cohort (3 customers) during first week, Dedicated opt-in ~4w after arrival subject to telemetry.

Rosa (SRE): priming jobs caused scale noise yesterday. can priming be ignored by autoscaler?

Arjun (Capacity): yes — adding traffic.tag=priming and a soft ignore (5% cluster). also adding dashboard annotations for priming windows.

Tom (Platform): finance wants a simple monthly delta for 2-node warm pool per APAC zone. any ballpark?

Priya (VP Infra): ballpark ~$6–8k/month per zone (SKU dependent). Tom will post exact sims by Friday.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: job "priming/apac-v2" started (jb-198888).

Priya (VP Infra): ACTIONS: 1) Tom: cost sims posted by Fri. 2) Arjun: priming tag + dashboard annotation. 3) Priya: publish model-eligibility blurb this week (exclude high-jitter quant profiles). will fold into all-hands notes.

Rosa (SRE): thanks  please ping when annotations live.

Priya (VP Infra): will do. thanks everyone — small follow-ups here; larger asks in #eng-oncall or RFCs.
